description:
## Background

The full React Doctor scan currently reports 31 warnings. Source-level evaluation separates them into actionable findings, findings already owned by the active Issue Explorer coordinator refactor, evidence-backed rejected diagnostics, and one developer-tool dependency that still needs human clarification.

This epic addresses the 16 actionable findings that are not already owned by `bsm-xii`. It deliberately targets an evidence-backed clean baseline rather than gaming the score: intentional non-passive gesture handling, a tiny non-hot array chain, ordinary top-level React `useContext`, and dynamically loaded tool dependencies should not be rewritten merely to silence heuristics.

The existing `bsm-xii.3` → `bsm-xii.4` sequence remains responsible for the three `App` diagnostics: giant component, related state publication, and the misclassified `confirmedWorkspacePath` state. No duplicate App-refactor child should be added here.

## What to build

Resolve the independently actionable React Doctor findings through five children: pnpm trust hardening, a deeper Workspace-selection interface, refresh-banner module isolation, dead renderer-interface contraction, and accurate dead-code entrypoint modeling for non-bundled tooling.

## Technical Approach

Publish each fix as an independently landable child. The children have no hard ordering dependencies. Final epic verification waits for all five children and for the existing `bsm-xii.4` coordinator cleanup before re-running the full scan and classifying any residual diagnostics from current evidence.

```mermaid
graph LR
    A[Harden pnpm dependency trust] --> V[Final React Doctor baseline]
    B[Deepen Workspace selection modules] --> V
    C[Isolate refresh banner selection] --> V
    D[Contract dead renderer interfaces] --> V
    E[Model non-bundled tooling entrypoints] --> V
    X3[bsm-xii.3 Extract coordinator] --> X4[bsm-xii.4 Consolidate publication]
    X4 --> V
```

## Considerations

- Do not convert `confirmedWorkspacePath` to a ref merely to satisfy React Doctor; it feeds Workspace traversal and is owned by `bsm-xii.3`.
- Keep Mermaid's wheel listener non-passive because its Ctrl/Meta zoom gesture intentionally calls `preventDefault()`.
- Do not rewrite the four-item Issue metadata chain without profiling evidence.
- Keep ordinary top-level `useContext`; React Doctor's React 19 recipe explicitly says a mechanical `use(Context)` replacement adds no correctness benefit.
- WDIO packages, Oxlint plugins, and React Doctor are dynamically invoked or loaded and are not unused merely because static import analysis cannot see them.
- `tauri-agent-tools` has no repository-owned invocation. Do not remove it in this epic without confirming whether it supports an undocumented manual workflow.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All five child issues are closed.
- [ ] `bsm-xii.4` is complete before the final baseline is assessed.
- [ ] Every remaining React Doctor warning has an evidence-backed disposition: resolved, rejected, or explicitly awaiting human information.
- [ ] No behavior, interface, dependency, or rule is changed solely to inflate the React Doctor score.
- [ ] `mise run doctor:react` completes and `mise run verify` passes.

## Test Plan

- Run focused tests named by each child.
- After all children and `bsm-xii.4` land, run `mise run doctor:react`.
- Run the full canonical mergeability gate with `mise run verify`.
- Record residual diagnostic dispositions in the epic before closing it.

## Triage

ready-for-agent after its child issues are published; children are independently ready.
title: Resolve actionable React Doctor findings and establish an evidence-backed baseline
